newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares barely lower in thin trade, off lows.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares barely lower in thin trade, off lows.

text.p: Istanbul shares ended little changed in range-bound and quiet trade on Tuesday as the index rebounded on support at near the index's 1,600 level, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 closed down three points, or 0.18 percent at 1,644 after brushing a low of 1,621. On Monday, it lost 1.32 percent in correction of last week's 4.6 percent jump.
Daily trade volume dived to 14.78 trillion lira ($103.2 million) from Monday's 18.48 trillion ($129 million).

"The index has strong support at 1,600. Technically, direction is up, but selective activity has not spilled over to the whole market because of ongoing political uncertainty," said Deniz Yurtseven from Ekinciler securities.
"If uncertainty fades, the market may rally towards 2,000 level this month," he added.
The index's all-time high close was 1,700 on January 27. The 1997 intra-day high was 1,751 in January.
Brokers said the market continued to watch political developments with less sensitivity than the previous weeks.
